main_text.l: LXIV.
Noui hæretici Pelagiani [Iesuitæ] religionis
amatores & laudatores videntur sibi esse sanc-
torum, si non audeant dicere imperfectæ illos
fuisse virtutis, cùm hoc confiteatur vas electi-onis, &c. ibid.
LXV.
Isti non intelligentes, & calumniandi cupi-
ditate cæcati, quàm diuersis modis Peccati no-
men in Scripturis poni solet ignorantes, pec-
catum Christi [i. e. Christum peccasse] affirmare
nos iactant. Dicimus itaque Christum, & nul-
lum habuisse peccatum, nec in anima, nec in car-
ne, & suscipiendo carnem in similitudine car-
nis peccati, de peccato damn[illegible, ~3 letters] peccatum. cap. 6.
LXVI.
Quicquid de laude legis & liberi arbitrii di-
cunt, ad hoc referre conantur, ut gratia non ad-
iuvet nisi meritum, ac si gratia jam non sit
gra-tia. Quicquid de laude Sanctorum, ad hoc, ut
vita mortalis in Sanctis videatur non habere
peccatum, nec sit eis necessarium pro dimitté-
dis debitis suis precari Deum. lib. 4. cap. 2.
LXVII.
Non tam contra hæreticos defendunt quā
contra Catholicos extollunt liberum arbitrium.
Et per arbitrii libertatem destruere volunt gratiæ largitorem. cap. 6. eiusd. lib.
LXVIII.
Verba vestra quò proficiunt, nisi ut appareat,
vel quomodo de fidei causa[?] scire negle-

page.notes: The blot over the page at "damn..." (about the middle of the LXV paragraph) hides about three letters; the reading "damnasse" is likely but not visible, so it is marked as illegible. "causa" in LXVIII is partly obscured and is marked [?]. "Iesuitæ" in LXIV is printed in italic inside square brackets, and the brackets are copied as printed. The paragraph ends with "negle-" at the foot of the page; the word continues on the next page. The faint marks at the lower left are show-through and are not transcribed.
